title: The Watch Checkpoint scene (Wardmoor north road, smuggler-boots flavor encounter) is a pure toll/friction node with no reward or story payoff either way — succeeding or paying just removes an artificial roadblock and can cost faction standing on a natural-1 fail, which feels like a punishing dead end rather than content.
